title: Zephyrine and the Orchard
author: Theo Almeida
blurb: Mirabel Oyelaran, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
